vendor/*: Rust vendor tree of the daemon: the crates' own files, kept as their authors wrote them (cargo checks them), as for LACT
rollupvendor/*: Rust vendor tree of Rollup's native part: the crates' own files, kept as their authors wrote them
rollup/*: Rollup's rust/ workspace, the source of the native part of the interface's bundler, kept as its authors wrote it
npm/*: the interface's node_modules, installed from the lock file and kept as their authors wrote them: a vendored tree is never projected
